text.title: Entity
text.body: Coordinate C2: 29 graph properties carried verbatim in this document's bimba field.

properties.q_0_instantiation_thrownness: C2 Entity does not begin; it is begun. Its thrown ground is C1 Form: an entity cannot stand until there is already a definitional pattern for it to instantiate — 'C1 Instantiated through C2' (CLAUDE.md II.E). Behind C1 stands C0 Bimba, the canonical source; so C2's horizon is the full descent #1 Definition arriving out of #0 Ground, the raw archetype #2 (Operation) emerging the instant a Form becomes available to be enacted. But the deeper, more honest void-pole is operational, not just genealogical: every entity here arises from an UNRESOLVED capture — the loose wikilink, the root-created note, the Empty-captured fragment that has a name but no settled home (C2.md, Hen Use). That pre-articulate residue is the 'that' C2 presupposes: there is a mention, a pointing-toward, before there is a thing. The entity is the resolution of that thrownness — Hen's routing through C2 after Empty capture is precisely the act of giving a captured pointer its first articulation as a discrete, propertied unit. C2's ground is therefore double: the prior Form it instantiates, and the unresolved reference it answers. It is the position that owes its existence to two debts at once — to the definition above it and to the unkept pointer behind it.
properties.q_2_individuation_through_capture: C2's home act is INDIVIDUATION — the move by which a Form becomes a this. It is the energetic position of the C family, and its dynamism is the Hen entity-capture lifecycle (C2.md): Hen routes unresolved wikilinks and root-created notes through C2 after Empty capture, then proposes aliases, properties, relation candidates, and coordinate homes for review. The entity here is graded, not flat — a ladder of substantiality from the entity_candidate (a file promoted from Empty) up to the canonical entity. C2 moves by promoting along that ladder: the cut that turns a shared Form into a particular, the operation by which essence takes on the hereness of an individual standing in the graph.
properties.q_3_entity_articulation_lattice: C2's structure is the entity-articulation lattice (C2.md): Entity-Candidates, Entities, Properties, Tags, Aliases, and Relation-Fields, each its own semantic subfolder. Its formal signature is atomicity — the bounded, countable unit — plus the relation-field evidence held here BEFORE S2 graph materialisation: the structured edges-in-waiting a canonical entity will carry once validated. The lattice is the discreteness the C family needs so a world is made of things and not only of natures, granular enough for a process to act upon.
properties.q_4_so_essence_is_actual: C2 is FOR actuality — it exists so a Form is not merely an abstract nature but stands as particulars one can point to, alias, tag, and relate. Its why is individuation made durable: without C2, C1's Forms would be real only as possibility, never as entities in the graph, and there would be nothing for relations to hold between. C2 is where the vault's essences acquire hereness and become addressable.
properties.q_5_entity_reveals_process: C2 completes by revealing its own processual nature — the Entity 'reveals its processual nature as' C3 (CLAUDE.md II.E). Held in time, an atomic unit is never finally static; it discloses that it is a doing as much as a thing, and hands itself onto the canvas where it becomes. Toward canon, stable entities graduate to flat World through C5. The individual completes by entering process: the this becomes the from-which of a becoming.
